name: Hygge

influenced_by: Danish cultural concept of cozy contentment

eras: the word is old Danish/Norwegian; its Western design/lifestyle-media popularity dates to c. 2016

media.title: Meik Wiking, The Little Book of Hygge (2016)
media.note: a major driver of the term's international popularity

reacts_against: the brief 2016-18 Western media cycle largely packaged hygge as decor and product marketing; critics (including Danish commentators) noted the real cultural concept is about social warmth, not candles and blankets.

findings: dark — about 43% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 54% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
